timecoded_text_to_speech.text: I need a very fabulous start to the Gibraltar chess festival.
First round draw against Lev Aronian.
Tell us what happened and how you're feeling right now.
Well, I'm very, very happy and I could not wait for this result.
Well, actually he played the first G6 and from the opening I think I played quite well.
Then he took the E5 pawn and after the game he said to me that he just see this bishop takes a 6 but instead of this I played the bishop f1.
After this I think I had a better position and then I took a pawn on b5.
And even after when he played the E5 he said that I had a winning move f4 which I didn't see.
Instead of I took the bishop on c8 and after I had a pawn more but I think I was better but I could not push more.
At the end it was a bishop ruchand game with a pawn but it was draw I think.
Throughout the game it did look like White had a slight pull and Black was always on the defense except the f4 moment that you say you missed it.
Did you at any point feel like you could probably have more?
Yeah, I felt that I'm better but I just could not see and my time was a little bit not too much so I was a bit nervous during the game.
But I was happy when I saw that I took the bishop and I cannot lose at least so for me the draw was fine for me.
Tell us a little bit about the preparation for this game.
When you're playing someone like Levan who plays everything and comes up with such interesting ideas over the board.
What was your preparation like?
Actually I just checked his game briefly and recently he just played E5 or G6 and what I just saw that when he plays against Wicker, much weaker player, he plays the G6 line.
So I was a bit prepared for this line but then he played this E6 which I just didn't know too much and then I just tried to make some moves from my head.
Despite having a better position, draw is a great result and you're happy with it.
I'm very very happy.
Yes, that's true. I'm happy.
And how are you going to celebrate?
I don't know today we will have this dinner gala so I will go there probably and I'll just drink and eat.
We'll have a great evening and we look forward to more fighting chess from you. We'll have you here soon.
Thank you very much.
Thanks Gaya.
Thanks for watching.
